narrative: 摄影机机身留在外面。镜筒本身则去到了摄影机去不了的地方：穿过饮料里的冰块、钻进齿轮之间、掠过一片桌面大小的森林、探进一只瓶子里。
镜筒尖端的视野常常很宽，所以一滴液体会变成一片湖泊，一粒面包屑会变成一块巨石，而运镜可以穿越这个世界。如果一支标准的微距镜头从外部就已经能看到你需要的表面，这就不是合适的工具。
对于一张人像来说，这也不是合适的工具；这种风格是“透过一个小孔的贴近感”，而不是一个85mm的单人镜头。如果你只是想在一个普通房间里用14mm拍摄，你想要的其实是14mm超广角，而不是探针镜头。
how: 装上探针镜头，保护好镜筒，规划一条镜筒尖端在物理上能够穿越的路径。从微小空间的外部打光，或者用光纤照亮内部；前镜片离主体很近，如果不小心，它会拍到你的挡光板。
即便光圈通常偏小，景深依然很浅，因为你离得太近了。要稳定运镜——几英寸的移动，等效于几英里。
提示词：Probe-lens view of [Subject], tiny wide lens on a stick, impossible proximity through glass, food, or machinery, miniature world.
when: 用它去到摄影机机身去不了的地方：穿过一杯饮料、深入一块手表内部、掠过一盘摆盘的食物，仿佛那是一片地貌。不要把它当作“从上方就能拍到的桌面微距”的同义词。
vs: 微距是从外部以高倍率拍摄一个小物体；探针镜头则会进入这个空间内部。
14mm超广角是用普通摄影机机身拍出的宽广视野；放大倍率是一个尺度概念，探针镜头则是一套传输系统，其尖端往往也偏广角。
examples_film: 商业美食和产品摄影经常使用探针镜头，让摄影机能够穿越气泡和装饰配菜。《霍比特人》系列中运用“微缩模型语言”的相近手法（以及类似的桌面/微缩模型摄影），都依赖于在人工搭建世界内部的微小视点。
把它们当作关于“不可能的贴近感”的语法来借鉴，而不是照搬的画面。
mistakes: 最常被搞混的近邻是从外部拍摄的微距，或者一个正常尺寸房间里的14mm画面。破绽是一张桌面静物画面，摄影机明显还在外部，或者一个普通的室内全景。
解决办法：视点来自一个微小空间的内部，运镜沿着镜筒的路径移动，尺度感在镜筒尖端呈现出偏广角的效果。

faq.q: What is a probe lens in film?
faq.a: 这是一支细长的近距离对焦光学镜头，其微小的前镜片能够进入狭小的空间。你能获得极致的贴近感，往往还能从一个物体或微缩布景内部拍出宽广的视野。
微距是从外部进行近距离对焦：镜头对准一个小物体。探针镜头则是一支能够穿过这个物体、或穿梭在物体之间的镜筒，摄影机机身始终留在这个微小空间之外。

faq.q: When should I use a probe lens?
faq.a: 当镜头必须穿越一杯饮料、一台机器、食物，或者摄影机机身无法进入的微小缝隙时使用它。如果一支普通的外部微距镜头已经能看到那个表面，就跳过它。

faq.q: How do I prompt a probe lens for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写：Probe-lens view of [Subject], tiny wide lens on a stick, impossible proximity through glass, food, or machinery, miniature world。点名穿越这个空间的路径。禁止普通人像和俯拍式的微距。

narrative: The camera body stays outside. The tube goes where a camera cannot: through ice in a drink, between gears, across a tabletop forest, into a bottle.

The view is often wide at the tip, so a drop of liquid becomes a lake and a crumb becomes a boulder, while the move can travel through that world. It is the wrong tool when a standard Macro from outside already sees the surface you need.
It is also the wrong tool for a face portrait; the look is proximity through a hole, not an 85mm single. If you only wanted a 14mm in a normal room, you wanted 14mm Ultra-Wide, not a probe.
how: Mount the probe, protect the barrel, and plan a path the tip can physically travel. Light from outside the tiny space or fiber the interior; the front element is close to the subject and will see your flags if you are careless.
Depth of field is still small despite the typical slow stop, because you are close. Stabilize the move; inches are miles.
Prompt: Probe-lens view of [Subject], tiny wide lens on a stick, impossible proximity through glass, food, or machinery, miniature world.
when: Use it to go where a camera body cannot: through a drink, into a watch, across a plated meal as if it were terrain. Do not use it as a synonym for macro on a tabletop you could shoot from above.
vs: Macro photographs a small object from outside at high scale. A probe enters the space.
14mm Ultra-Wide is a wide field from a normal camera body. Magnification is the scale; the probe is a delivery system that also tends to be wide at the tip.
examples_film: Commercial food and product work uses probes constantly so a camera can travel through bubbles and garnish. The Hobbit's miniature-language cousins (and similar tabletop/miniature photography) rely on tiny viewpoints inside constructed worlds.
Treat those as grammar for impossible proximity, not as a still to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Macro from outside, or a 14mm in a full-size room. The tell is a tabletop still with the camera clearly outside, or a normal interior wide.
Fix: viewpoint from inside a small space, barrel-path move, wide-at-the-tip scale.

faq.q: What is a probe lens in film?
faq.a: It is a long, narrow close-focus optic whose tiny front element can enter small spaces. You get extreme proximity and, often, a wide view from inside an object or miniature set.
Macro is close-focus from outside: a lens aimed at a small object. A probe is a barrel that can pass through that object or between objects, with the camera body remaining outside the tiny space.

faq.q: When should I use a probe lens?
faq.a: Use it when the shot must travel through a drink, a machine, food, or a miniature gap a camera body cannot enter. Skip it if a normal macro from outside already sees the surface.

faq.q: How do I prompt a probe lens for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write: Probe-lens view of [Subject], tiny wide lens on a stick, impossible proximity through glass, food, or machinery, miniature world. Name the path through the space. Forbid ordinary portraits and overhead macros.
